section: National Cyber Security Policy 2013 and the national cyber crime policy framework
subsections: ITU Global Cybersecurity Index - India's tier and rank
Awareness and workforce - ISEA, cyber hygiene campaigns

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding India's performance in the ITU Global Cybersecurity Index 2024:
1. India received a score of 98.49.
2. India was assessed as strong in all five pillars of cybersecurity.
3. India was assigned a numerical rank instead of a tier.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: India received a score of 98.49 and was strong in all five pillars. Statement 3 is false because the 2024 Index uses tiers instead of numerical ranks.
accepted.tq: Find the false statement by distinguishing the current tier system from the earlier ranking system.
accepted.sec: ITU Global Cybersecurity Index - India's tier and rank

accepted.s: India was ranked 10th in which edition of the ITU Global Cybersecurity Index?
accepted.x: India was ranked 10th in the GCI 2020. The GCI 2024 shifted from numerical ranks to tiers.
accepted.tq: Numerical-year discrimination between the earlier rank-based edition and the later tier-based edition.
accepted.sec: ITU Global Cybersecurity Index - India's tier and rank

accepted.s: ISEA, associated with cybersecurity awareness and capacity building in India, stands for:
accepted.x: ISEA stands for Information Security Education and Awareness.
accepted.tq: Direct recall of the expansion of a commonly confusable cybersecurity acronym.
accepted.sec: Awareness and workforce - ISEA, cyber hygiene campaigns

accepted.s: Which Union Ministry is associated with the ISEA capacity-building project?
o: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology
accepted.x: ISEA is a capacity-building project of the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY).
accepted.tq: Who-would-do-this-job method for identifying the responsible ministry.
accepted.sec: Awareness and workforce - ISEA, cyber hygiene campaigns

accepted.s:
With reference to CERT-In's workforce-development activities in 2024, consider the following statements:
1. It trained 12,014 IT professionals.
2. The training was conducted through 23 training programmes.
3. The training was conducted by the NM-ICPS.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: CERT-In trained 12,014 IT professionals through 23 trainings in 2024. Statement 3 is false; NM-ICPS supports cybersecurity and AI research but was not identified as the agency conducting these CERT-In trainings.
accepted.tq: Separate the agency responsible for training from the programme that supports research.
accepted.sec: Awareness and workforce - ISEA, cyber hygiene campaigns

accepted.s: The National Mission on Interdisciplinary Cyber-Physical Systems (NM-ICPS) supports research primarily in which area mentioned in the context of cybersecurity capacity building?
o: Universal acceptance of Indian language domains
Digital arrest investigation and victim restoration
accepted.x: NM-ICPS supports cybersecurity and artificial intelligence research.
accepted.tq: Application of the mission's stated research focus without confusing it with awareness campaigns or policing.
accepted.sec: Awareness and workforce - ISEA, cyber hygiene campaigns

accepted.s: The Telangana Cyber Security Bureau's campaign titled “#OnlineButUnafraid” was aimed at which group?
o: Victims seeking restoration after digital arrest fraud
State police officers responsible for critical infrastructure
accepted.x: The Telangana Cyber Security Bureau launched the #OnlineButUnafraid campaign for women journalists.
accepted.tq: Direct recall of the campaign-name and target-group pairing.
accepted.sec: Awareness and workforce - ISEA, cyber hygiene campaigns

accepted.s: Which one of the following correctly identifies the subject of the Supreme Court order referred to in the context of current cybercrime concerns?
o: Implementation of the Andhra Pradesh Cyber Security Policy
Ranking of countries in the ITU Global Cybersecurity Index
Training of IT professionals through ISEA
Digital-arrest standard operating procedures and restoration of victims' losses
accepted.x: The Supreme Court order concerned standard operating procedures for digital arrests and restoration of victims' losses.
accepted.tq: Identify the institutional subject matter rather than matching the issue with a similarly related cyber programme.

accepted.s: CERT-In incidents reached approximately what level in 2025, described as a five-year high?
accepted.x: CERT-In recorded 29.44 lakh incidents in 2025, described as a five-year high.
accepted.tq: Place-value discrimination among closely related numerical options.

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements about the National Cyber Security Policy 2013:
1. It had not been updated even by the time of the criticism referred to in the material.
2. Weak coordination was identified among CERT-In, the MHA portal and State police.
3. The criticism stated that coordination among these bodies was fully effective.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: The 2013 policy was criticised for never having been updated, and coordination among CERT-In, the MHA portal and State police was described as weak. Statement 3 reverses that criticism.
accepted.tq: Use the negative statement carefully: the criticism concerned weak, not fully effective, coordination.

accepted.s: Which of the following correctly describes the implementation arrangement for the Andhra Pradesh Cyber Security Policy 2017?
o: It is implemented by APTS and includes four verticals.
It is implemented by NM-ICPS through two research pillars.
It is implemented by the MHA portal through three verticals.
It is implemented by CERT-In through five national pillars.
accepted.x: The Andhra Pradesh Cyber Security Policy 2017 has four verticals and is implemented by APTS.
accepted.tq: Match the policy with its implementing agency and stated structural arrangement.

accepted.s: One of the verticals of the Andhra Pradesh Cyber Security Policy 2017 relates to:
o: Replacing the ITU Global Cybersecurity Index with a national rank
Administering the Supreme Court's digital-arrest SOPs
accepted.x: Securing critical government infrastructure is one of the four verticals of the Andhra Pradesh Cyber Security Policy 2017.
accepted.tq: Direct identification of a policy vertical from closely related cyber-governance functions.

accepted.s: Which of the following is another stated vertical of the Andhra Pradesh Cyber Security Policy 2017?
accepted.x: Capacity building is one of the four verticals of the Andhra Pradesh Cyber Security Policy 2017.
accepted.tq: Direct recall of the policy's capacity-building component.

accepted.s:
Arrange the following in chronological order:
A. Andhra Pradesh Cyber Security Policy
B. ITU Global Cybersecurity Index edition in which India was ranked 10th
C. ITU Global Cybersecurity Index edition in which India was placed in Tier-1
D. CERT-In incidents reaching a five-year high of 29.44 lakh

Select the correct sequence.
accepted.x: The chronological order is Andhra Pradesh Cyber Security Policy 2017, GCI 2020, GCI 2024, and the CERT-In incident figure for 2025.
accepted.tq: Use the years attached to the policy, GCI editions and incident data; first and last items fix the sequence.
